ticket.title: verifying a cross-store dependency never unblocks its dependent, so a recorded cross-repo block can never be satisfied
ticket.description:
Measured 2026-11-10, immediately after MTR-1 was verified. SP-40 carried a blocked_by edge to MTR-1 (recorded when SP-48 made cross-store edges possible), MTR-1 is now Verified in the miter store, and SP-40 still reads Blocked. The reason is the unblock half: verify_task walks its own store looking for Blocked dependents and records StatusChanged to Ready for those whose dependencies are satisfied, so a dependent in another repository is never visited. unpark does not rescue it either - it asks is_task_dependency_ready over the same local map, the foreign target is absent, and is_none_or treats an unknown target as unverified, so unpark parks it straight back to Blocked. That default is the safe one and I do not want it changed blindly: the fix is for readiness to consult the suite when a blocked_by target is not in this store, the same way SP-48 link resolution now does. Consequence for the burn-down: a cross-repository dependency can be recorded but never satisfied, which makes the edge advisory rather than blocking - worse than before SP-48, where it could not be recorded at all and the ticket simply read Ready and lied. Acceptance: verifying MTR-1 moves a dependent SP-40 in another store to Ready without touching SP-40; a dependent whose target is genuinely unverified stays Blocked; and a member-only checkout with the target repository absent keeps it Blocked rather than guessing.

JUDGED 2026-11-12: LIVE AND UNFIXED, code path named. verify_task unblocks dependents by walking its own store - `get_all_tasks(store.conn())` at ops/verification/mod.rs:197 - then filtering Blocked tasks with a BlockedBy edge to the verified task. A dependent in another repository is never in that map, so a recorded cross-store block can never be satisfied: exactly what the ticket measured when MTR-1 was verified and SP-40 stayed Blocked.

The fix is not local, which is why it was not done in passing: the unblock must consult the unified workspace index for foreign dependents and record the StatusChanged in the store that OWNS the dependent, not the one that was verified. workspace::store already exposes the unified index and link_to_target (SP-48) made the edges cross-store; what is missing is the write-back half. Acceptance stands as filed.
